representative_scale.policy: One fixed representative scale; edit nOptions and rebuild once. No search, doubling or toy extrapolation; report timeout if budget exceeded.

outputs.exit_status: Preserve benchmark exit status and Test passed/Test failed verdict.

evaluator_interface.description: Shakedown stand-in evaluator: counts the arm's output files and checks the digest of a private reference file
evaluator_interface.reason: Source and immutable identifier not supplied.

timing_scope.streamed: Published host timer: input preprocessing, H2D transfer, GPU pricing, D2H transfer and event completion; excludes allocation/RNG initialization, CPU result finalization, validation and compilation.
timing_scope.trusted_wall: Whole arm invocation measured externally, in seconds; distinct from internal mc_ms.
timing_scope.threaded: p2 uses the published threaded path; retain its reported internal time and trusted wall separately.

scoring_interface.reserve: Check strict >1 using verdict or unrounded statistic; preserve output extraction and exit status.
scoring_interface.comparison: Use supplied output selectors and metric definitions; no invented A0/A1 agreement tolerance or evaluator acceptance rule.

stage_budgets_reason: No measured runtime evidence supports estimates or overrides. Supplied args budgets are empty; use pipeline defaults.

budget_policy.setup_anchors_profile: Use remaining run-ceiling time when args budgets absent; ceiling is not a target.
budget_policy.timeout: Enforce applicable stage budget; do not change scale after timeout.

gate_scripts_reason: No gate scripts named in supplied sources.
